senses.definition: vb. sign, mark, describe with a mark (so Ges (who compares תאה, תוה) DlPr 116 (not W)) only
Pf. הִתְאַוִּיתֶם לָכֶם mark you out, measure, Nu 34:10 (P), so Vrss (cf. תְּתָאוּ לָכֶם v 7, 8; v. however Di, & sub I. אוה).—V. also [תָּאַר] on p. 1061.
